descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: tab/editor interleaving; nearest TFA-94699 AC 5.

Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S14 Nursing Home: a card added on the tab after the editor was opened, and a card deleted there, across Save Note

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 Re-saving the pre-round note with different content leaves every point untouched: Save Note never adds, edits, or removes a point. (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 2; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • T3 A deleted Important Point never comes back unless the physician enters it again. (TFA-94699 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes. (UAT TC-12; UAT 3.3; TFA-92590 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Nursing Home resident with one card added on the tab

When Open the editor and close it without typing; add a second card on the tab; open the editor, type a note, Save Note. Then open and close the editor again, delete the first card on the tab, open the editor and Save Note

Then After the first Save Note both cards are there; after the second, the deleted card is still gone (checkpoint 2 judges only the deleted card, so a loss in part 1 does not count twice)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U3 (Save Note never adds or removes) and T3 (a deleted point never comes back). Known gap: TFA-92590 2026-10-09 audit ('cards get lost, deleted cards come back'). cp1's missing 'Added after closing editor: call son' reports as Fail (known). …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S14 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-12.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-12 Important Points · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-12/S14

Nursing Home: a card added on the tab after the editor was opened, and a card deleted there, across Save Note

Tickets: TFA-92590 Important Points (ready for qa); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

New local lane newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

Detail:

Both cards kept after the first Save Note; the deleted card stays gone after the second. On 8b4be94a there is no points panel on the tab, so the 'added on the tab' step is done in the editor. Judged checks 2/2.

Evidence: 2 attached.
